hero.lead: CompliHub360 orchestrates the transition from vague legal requirements to executable, expert-backed expansion strategies.

domains.title: Core Compliance Domains
domains.lead: Precise, structured navigation through specialized regulatory fields tailored for international expansion.

tax.title: Tax & VAT
tax.desc: Monitoring delivery thresholds and identifying registration obligations for cross-border commerce. Physical vs. digital goods regulations and revenue band checks.

product.title: EPR & Packaging
product.desc: Structured navigation through local packaging laws and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR). Categorization for manufacturers, resellers, and dropshippers.

data.title: Data & Privacy
data.desc: Risk analysis regarding the GDPR, cookie compliance, tracking tools, and international data transfers. Evaluation of GA4, Meta, and Consent Systems.

marketing.title: Marketing Compliance
marketing.desc: Validation of advertising claims (e.g., Health Claims) and prevention of legal warnings. Risk assessment based on marketing channels and industry sensitivity.

corporate.title: Corporate & Structure
corporate.desc: Support for selecting the right legal entity and handling registrations in new target markets. Structural compliance for international expansion.

risk.title: Intelligent Risk Analysis
risk.desc: Complete an adaptive wizard to receive a structured overview of legal duties based on validated sources.

matching.title: Orchestrated Expert Matching
matching.desc: Pre-qualified specialists via structured Engagement Requests. Guaranteed SLA confirmation and response times.

monitoring.title: Monitoring & Dashboard
monitoring.desc: Save profiles, track request status, and export PDF reports for team sharing and internal audits.

privacy.title: Privacy-First AI
privacy.text: AI structures info, but local redaction strips PII before processing.

sla.title: SLA Monitoring
sla.text: Continuous monitoring of partner response times and quality.

sources.title: No Hallucinations
sources.text: Every recommendation is grounded in direct links to validated legal sources.
